claims: The Pentagon's fiscal 2027 budget request seeks to purchase 85 F-35 Lightning II fighters.
47 F-35 Lightning II fighters were requested in FY2026.
The Pentagon's fiscal 2027 F-35 plan includes 38 F-35A models for the Air Force.
The Pentagon's fiscal 2027 F-35 plan includes 10 F-35B for the Marine Corps.
The Pentagon's fiscal 2027 F-35 plan includes 37 F-35C for the Navy.
The fiscal 2027 F-35 total request is 85 aircraft.
32 F-35 aircraft are included in the fiscal 2027 base budget.
53 F-35 aircraft are contingent on congressional approval of a $350 billion reconciliation package.
The fiscal 2027 F-35 budget is part of a proposed $1.5 trillion defense budget.
The fiscal 2027 F-35 request marks a ~81% increase in requested units from FY2026.
The budget request is part of a broader push involving a $6.6 billion contract for F-35 engine lots 18 and 19.
